text:
mira: quick heads-up — ran a prod-sim profile with continuous-batcher under mixed 2k-8k seq workloads. Seeing recurring KV cache pressure spikes when the batcher merges long-prefix requests; a few soft-evictions and oom-guard handoffs popped in the trace. Trace: https://internal/trace/2351

mira: sample logs:
```
[2026-03-10T14:22:31Z] kv_cache: free=1.1GB headroom=1.15GB evict=soft
[2026-03-10T14:22:31Z] batcher: formed_batch tokens=4096 queued=12 admitted=9
[2026-03-10T14:22:31Z] oom_guard: triggered kernel_fallback=true
```

alex: can you paste the batcher/admission config used for that run? token_target looks suspiciously high for mixed lengths.

mira: here was the runtime config for the run:
```json
{
  "batcher": {"token_target": 1024, "max_batch_tokens": 8192, "kv_headroom_bytes": 1342177280},
  "admission": {"late_admit_threshold_ms": 6}
}
```

sam: fwiw we merged the kernel-selection change yesterday that pulled heavier kernels into the fast-path. I measured ~+6% resident mem on similar traces — that plus large batch merges could push us past soft headroom. Might be two orthogonal issues compounding.

alex: quick experiment proposal: lower token_target -> 512, and add an admission pre-check that gates prefix-merge when kv.free < kv_headroom * 1.1. Also delay kernel-route decision until after admission so we don't pick kernels that assume extra KV workspace. Pseudocode:
```
if kv.free_bytes < kv.headroom_bytes * 1.1:
  disallow_prefix_merge()
else:
  pick_kernel_after_admit(requests)
```

mira: :eyes: sounds reasonable. I'll kick off a 30m A/B (kv-admit-v2) on prod-sim with those params and tag results.

ci-bot: deploy: queued ci/perf/kv-admit-v2 (#4523) — started. https://ci/internal/4523

sam: if this lowers throughput too much, fallback plan: keep token_target conservative (512), but allow a fast quantized kernel fallback for rejected merges so latency isn't terrible. I'll add a `kernel_selector.pre_admit_check = true` flag and a fallback path.

alex: :thumbsup: also add metrics: `batch.kv_admit_rejections`, `batch.kv_reject_reason`, and `kv.eviction_rate` so we can correlate.

mira: will do. Running now; will post perf & eviction histos in ~35m. If anything spikes, ping @oncall immediately.

sam: action items summarized:
- sam: add kernel_selector.pre_admit_check + quantized fallback (PR queued)
- alex: add metrics and dashboard tiles for admit_rejections & eviction_rate
- mira: run A/B, collect traces, and share histograms
- ci-bot: keep the perf job logs on the run link

mira: thanks — appreciate quick responses.
